skinEditor.addRule: Add a rule for this part
skinEditor.addRuleAdvanced: Add a rule for this part (Advanced)
skinEditor.advancedHelp: Shows the skin's own style sheet. Everything else works without it.
skinEditor.allGood: The skin can be worn as it is.
skinEditor.author: Author
skinEditor.coloursFrom: Take the colours of a theme …
skinEditor.coloursHelp: A skin with colours of its own brings all of them, for dark and for light; without, it wears the installation's.
skinEditor.cssHelp: Rules name parts as [data-part=card], never classes. nexdeck writes the sheet anew from what it allows and says on which line something is not.
skinEditor.draftFound: This browser kept changes that were not saved.
skinEditor.framesHelp: A frame is cut from a sprite: its corners stay, its sides repeat. A part wears one in the inspector.
skinEditor.inspectHelp: Click a part on the stage to give it a frame, a motion, a sound or a decoration.
skinEditor.keyHelp: Lower case letters, digits and dashes; it names the skin in files.
skinEditor.keyLocked: Stays as it was saved: accounts wear the skin by it.
skinEditor.label: Name
skinEditor.name: Name
skinEditor.noDecorations: nexdeck draws on this part itself; it takes no decoration.

on.hover: When the pointer is over it

skinEditor.optionsHelp: Choices the wearer makes, such as a plain desk or bricks. The style sheet asks for one as :option(desk=plain).

page.title: Skin workshop
page.help: Skins redraw nexdeck beyond its colours. Build one here, bring one in, and choose which is the default for everybody.

kind.copy: A copy of a skin here

page.shopHelp: Skins others shared in the Workshop. Install one with a click; it then stands in the list above and can be made the default.

skinEditor.pickHelp: Click a part on the stage. Its frame, motion, sound and decorations are set here.
skinEditor.pictureHelp: Brings in a small picture: at most 32 by 32 pixels and 16 colours.
skinEditor.spriteUsed: The skin still uses it; take it out of there first.
skinEditor.statusHelp: Sprites for the lights of a card. Fine, warning and fault have to differ in shape, not only in colour.
skinEditor.tint: Shape only (takes the colour of the text)
skinEditor.weakHelp: {{count}} colours read below 4.5:1; the hint is on the colour itself.

ai.help: Say what the skin should look like. The assistant makes or changes it, the stage wears it, and the stage then tells it what reads badly.
ai.helpSees: Say what the skin should look like. The assistant makes or changes it, then looks at the stage once and improves what does not fit yet.
ai.prompt: What the skin should look like
ai.placeholder: Like a game console of the nineties: bold colours, thick round frames, bricks behind the cards
ai.making: The assistant is making the skin …
ai.lookingNow: The assistant looks at the stage …
ai.looking: Showing the assistant the stage, dark and light.
ai.checking: The stage found {{count}} things to tell the assistant.
ai.improved: Improved after a look at the stage.
ai.unchanged: After a look at the stage it stays as it is.
ai.failed: The assistant's skin could not be worn:
ai.locksHelp: What is locked stays exactly as it is, whatever the assistant does.
